BINDING_HEADER_KARTCRAFT = "World of Kartcraft" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_ACCELERATE = "Accelerate" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_BRAKE = "Brake / Reverse" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_STEERLEFT = "Steer Left" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_STEERRIGHT = "Steer Right" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_REVERSE = "Reverse" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_HOP = "Hop / Powerslide" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_BOOST = "Boost (Second Shoulder)" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_FIRE = "Fire Item" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_CAMERA = "Toggle Camera Distance" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_LOOKBACK = "Look Back" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_ABILITY1 = "Wumpa Juice" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_ABILITY2 = "Turbo Boost" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_ABILITY3 = "Super Engine" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_ABILITY4 = "Aku Aku" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_SUMMON = "Summon / Dismiss Kart" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_RACEFINDER = "Race Finder" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_LEAVERACE = "Leave Race" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_UNSTUCK = "Unstuck" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_RESTART = "Restart Time Trial" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_JOBS = "Courier Jobs" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_SETTINGS = "Kartcraft Settings" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_GARAGE = "Kart Garage" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_CLEANSCREEN = "Clean Screen (hide all interface)" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_FREECAM = "Free Camera (fly, park, off)" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_NEXTKART = "Next Kart" BINDING_NAME_KARTCRAFT_GUIDE = "Kartcraft Guide" BENILLA_KART_PREFIX = "KARTCRAFT" -- What the finder offers, { key, name } in the kart's order, from BENILLA_KART_COURSES: -- the zones, keyed "z<place>". BenillaKartCourses = {} -- Every course's name by key, from BENILLA_KART_COURSE_NAMES. BenillaKartCourseNames = {} -- The rows the list shows at once, and their height. BENILLA_KART_ROWS = 8 BENILLA_KART_ROW_HEIGHT = 24 BENILLA_KART_HEARTBEAT = 2 BENILLA_KART_RACING = "You're in a race: finish it, or leave it with /leaverace, first." BENILLA_KART_XP_COLOR = { r = 111 / 255, g = 111 / 255, b = 1 } BENILLA_KART_SKILL_COLOR = { r = 0.4, g = 0.8, b = 1 }
-- The finder's state: what is ticked (by course key, so a scroll moves no tick), what we -- queued for and the server's word on it. BenillaKartFinder = { any = 1, picked = {}, beat = 0, noticeUntil = 0, search = "" } -- While the finder is open: how many wait for each zone (by key) and the races hosted at a -- start ({ id, course, host, racers }), from the server's "Lobby" answer every 2 s. BenillaKartLobby = { counts = {}, races = {}, beat = 0 } BENILLA_KART_LOBBY_ROWS = 3
function BenillaKart_Send(body) SendAddonMessage(BENILLA_KART_PREFIX, "R\t" .. body, "PARTY") end
-- Our time trial under way, its race id: the race we are on the roster of (L), a time -- trial (TT), while the kart races (BenillaKartMap_SetTrack). function BenillaKart_TrialRace() local race = BenillaKartRaceNow if race and BenillaKartRaceTrial[race] and BenillaKartShortcuts.racing then return race end end
-- Our time trial over from its line, as the Restart binding has it ("TR"). function BenillaKart_RestartTrial() local race = BenillaKart_TrialRace() if race then BenillaKart_Send("TR\t" .. race) end end
-- Another go at the time trial just over (the way out's Retry), its spot to go back to kept. function BenillaKart_Retry() local course = BenillaKartRetryButton.course if course then BenillaKart_Send("TA\t" .. course) end end
-- Out of every race and the queue, whatever the kart or the server thinks. function BenillaKart_LeaveRace() BenillaKart_Send("X") end
-- `text` cut at each TAB. function BenillaKart_Split(text) local out, from = {}, 1 while true do local at = string.find(text, "\t", from, 1) if not at then table.insert(out, string.sub(text, from)) return out end table.insert(out, string.sub(text, from, at - 1)) from = at + 1 end end
function BenillaKart_CourseName(key) if BenillaKartCourseNames[key] then return BenillaKartCourseNames[key] end for i = 1, table.getn(BenillaKartCourses) do if BenillaKartCourses[i].key == key then return BenillaKartCourses[i].name end end if key == "any" then return "any course" end -- A player track, by the server's list of them. if string.sub(key or "", 1, 3) == "pt-" then local id = string.sub(key, 4) for i = 1, table.getn(BenillaKartPubTracks) do if BenillaKartPubTracks[i].id == id then return BenillaKartPubTracks[i].name end end return "a player track" end return key end
-- "any", or the ticked courses' keys. function BenillaKartFinder_Keys() local f = BenillaKartFinder local keys = "" if not f.any then for i = 1, table.getn(BenillaKartCourses) do local key = BenillaKartCourses[i].key if f.picked[key] then if keys ~= "" then keys = keys .. "," end keys = keys .. key end end end if keys == "" then return "any" end return keys end
function BenillaKartFinder_Queue() local f = BenillaKartFinder if f.mode == "player" then if not f.track then return end f.queued = "pt-" .. f.track else f.queued = BenillaKartFinder_Keys() end f.waiting, f.waited, f.noticeUntil = nil, nil, 0 BenillaKart_Send("Q+\t" .. f.queued) f.beat = GetTime() + BENILLA_KART_HEARTBEAT end
function BenillaKartFinder_Leave() local f = BenillaKartFinder f.queued, f.waiting, f.waited = nil, nil, nil BenillaKart_Send("Q-") end
-- A tick: nil is "Any course", else a course's key. Changing the courses while queued -- keeps the place. function BenillaKartFinder_Pick(key) local f = BenillaKartFinder if not key then f.any, f.picked = 1, {} else if f.picked[key] then f.picked[key] = nil else f.picked[key] = 1 end f.any = nil if not next(f.picked) then f.any = 1 end end if f.queued then BenillaKartFinder_Queue() end BenillaKartFinder_Refresh() end
function BenillaKartFinder_QueueClick() if BenillaKartFinder.queued then BenillaKartFinder_Leave() else BenillaKartFinder_Queue() end BenillaKartFinder_Refresh() end
function BenillaKartFinder_Answer(accept) local f = BenillaKartFinder local check = f.check if not check or check.answered then return end check.answered = 1 if accept then BenillaKart_Send("Y\t" .. check.id) else BenillaKart_Send("N\t" .. check.id) f.check, f.queued = nil, nil end end
function BenillaKartFinder_Toggle() if BenillaKartFinderFrame:IsVisible() then BenillaKartFinderFrame:Hide() else BenillaKart_Open(BenillaKartFinderFrame) end end
-- The status line: the ready check, a refusal, the queue, or how to start. function BenillaKartFinder_Status() local f = BenillaKartFinder if f.check then if f.check.answered then return "Race ready: waiting for the others..." end return "Race ready: " .. BenillaKart_CourseName(f.check.course) end if not f.queued then if GetTime() < f.noticeUntil then return BENILLA_KART_RACING end if f.mode == "player" then if table.getn(BenillaKartPubTracks) == 0 then return "No player tracks published yet." end return "Pick a player track: find a race on it, or run a time trial." end return "Pick zones and find a race." end local names = "" local keys = BenillaKart_Split(string.gsub(f.queued, ",", "\t")) for i = 1, table.getn(keys) do if names ~= "" then names = names .. ", " end names = names .. BenillaKart_CourseName(keys[i]) end -- A long pick reads as a count; the ticks in the list say which. if table.getn(keys) > 3 then names = table.getn(keys) .. " zones" end if not f.waited then return "In queue: " .. names end return format("In queue: %s\n%d:%02d, %d waiting", names, floor(f.waited / 60), mod(f.waited, 60), f.waiting) end
-- The finder's view while open: on the frame after a reply, else four times a second (its -- status reads the clock); a click redraws it at once itself. BENILLA_KART_FINDER_PERIOD = 0.25 function BenillaKartFinder_Tick(elapsed) local f = BenillaKartFinder f.since = (f.since or 0) + (elapsed or 0) if f.dirty or f.since >= BENILLA_KART_FINDER_PERIOD then f.dirty, f.since = nil, 0 BenillaKartFinder_Refresh() end end
function BenillaKartFinder_Refresh() local frame = BenillaKartFinderFrame if not frame:IsVisible() then return end local f = BenillaKartFinder getglobal("BenillaKartFinderFrameAny"):SetChecked(f.any) -- The tab: the courses' ticks, or the player tracks to pick one. local player = f.mode == "player" for _, part in ipairs(BENILLA_KART_FINDER_COURSE_PARTS) do local widget = getglobal("BenillaKartFinderFrame" .. part) if player then widget:Hide() else widget:Show() end end if player then for i = 1, BENILLA_KART_ROWS do getglobal("BenillaKartFinderFrameRow" .. i):Hide() end BenillaKartFinderFramePlayer:Show() BenillaKartFinderPlayer_Update() else BenillaKartFinderFramePlayer:Hide() BenillaKartFinder_UpdateList() end if player and not f.track and not f.queued then BenillaKartFinderFrameQueue:Disable() else BenillaKartFinderFrameQueue:Enable() end if f.queued then BenillaKartFinderFrameQueue:SetText("Leave queue") BenillaKartFinderFrameClose:SetText("Minimize") else BenillaKartFinderFrameQueue:SetText("Find race") BenillaKartFinderFrameClose:SetText("Close") end BenillaKartFinderFrameStatus:SetText(BenillaKartFinder_Status()) BenillaKartLobby_Update() end
-- What the list shows: every entry whose name holds the search, any case. function BenillaKartFinder_Shown() local search = string.lower(BenillaKartFinder.search or "") if search == "" then return BenillaKartCourses end local n = table.getn(BenillaKartCourses) local kept = BenillaKartFinder.shown if kept and kept.search == search and kept.courses == BenillaKartCourses and kept.n == n then return kept.list end local shown = {} for i = 1, n do local course = BenillaKartCourses[i] if string.find(string.lower(course.name), search, 1, 1) then table.insert(shown, course) end end BenillaKartFinder.shown = { search = search, courses = BenillaKartCourses, n = n, list = shown } return shown end
-- The search box's text: the list filters and goes back to its head. function BenillaKartFinder_Search(text) BenillaKartFinder.search = text or "" local bar = getglobal("BenillaKartFinderFrameScrollScrollBar") if bar then bar:SetValue(0) end BenillaKartFinder_Refresh() end
-- The course rows over the list from the scroll's offset; the stock faux kit's bar where it -- is loaded, else the list's head. function BenillaKartFinder_UpdateList() local list = BenillaKartFinder_Shown() local count = table.getn(list) local offset = 0 if FauxScrollFrame_Update then local scroll = BenillaKartFinderFrameScroll FauxScrollFrame_Update(scroll, count, BENILLA_KART_ROWS, BENILLA_KART_ROW_HEIGHT) if BenillaScrollTrough_Follow then BenillaScrollTrough_Follow(scroll:GetName()) end offset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(scroll) end for i = 1, BENILLA_KART_ROWS do local row = getglobal("BenillaKartFinderFrameRow" .. i) local course = list[offset + i] if course then row.key = course.key local label = getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Text") local queued = BenillaKartLobby.counts[course.key] if label then if queued then label:SetText(course.name .. " |cff40ff40(" .. queued .. " queued)|r") else label:SetText(course.name) end end row:SetChecked(BenillaKartFinder.picked[course.key]) row:Show() else row.key = nil row:Hide() end end end
-- The server's "Lobby": "<key>=<n>,..." waiting for each zone, "<id>:<course>:<host>:<n>;..." -- the hosted races still waiting for their host's start. function BenillaKartLobby_Set(counts, races) local l = BenillaKartLobby l.counts, l.races = {}, {} local items = BenillaKart_Split((string.gsub(counts or "", ",", "\t"))) for i = 1, table.getn(items) do local eq = string.find(items[i], "=", 1, 1) if eq then l.counts[string.sub(items[i], 1, eq - 1)] = tonumber(string.sub(items[i], eq + 1)) end end items = BenillaKart_Split((string.gsub(races or "", ";", "\t"))) for i = 1, table.getn(items) do local f = BenillaKart_Split((string.gsub(items[i], ":", "\t"))) if f[4] then table.insert(l.races, { id = f[1], course = f[2], host = f[3], racers = tonumber(f[4]) or 0 }) end end end
-- The hosted races under the list, each with its Join; past the rows, a count. -- ponytail: the first BENILLA_KART_LOBBY_ROWS only; scroll them if hosts get many. function BenillaKartLobby_Update() local races = BenillaKartLobby.races local count = table.getn(races) if count == 0 then BenillaKartFinderFrameLobbies:SetText("Hosted races: none. A Race Marshal hosts one at a course's start.") elseif count > BENILLA_KART_LOBBY_ROWS then BenillaKartFinderFrameLobbies:SetText("Hosted races (" .. count .. ", the first " .. BENILLA_KART_LOBBY_ROWS .. ")") else BenillaKartFinderFrameLobbies:SetText("Hosted races") end for i = 1, BENILLA_KART_LOBBY_ROWS do local row = getglobal("BenillaKartFinderFrameLobby" .. i) local race = races[i] if race then row.id = race.id local racers = race.racers .. " racers" if race.racers == 1 then racers = "1 racer" end getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Text"):SetText(format("%s: %s, %s", BenillaKart_CourseName(race.course), race.host, racers)) row:Show() else row.id = nil row:Hide() end end end
-- Into a hosted race from the list, from anywhere: the server puts us in the kart and on -- its roster, and the host's start brings everyone to the grid. function BenillaKartLobby_Join(row) if row and row.id then BenillaKart_Send("LJ\t" .. row.id) end end
function BenillaKartFinder_OnMouseWheel(delta) if BenillaFauxScrollFrame_OnMouseWheel then local scroll = BenillaKartFinderFrameScroll if BenillaKartFinder.mode == "player" then scroll = BenillaKartFinderFramePlayerScroll end BenillaFauxScrollFrame_OnMouseWheel(scroll, delta) end end
-- ── The Player tracks tab: the tracks players published (BenillaKartPubTracks, the -- server's list, asked for as the tab opens), one picked, raced through the queue by its -- course key ("pt-<id>", Kartcraft.cpp's player courses) or time-trialled ("TB"). BENILLA_KART_FINDER_COURSE_PARTS = { "Search", "Any", "Scroll" } BENILLA_KART_PLAYER_ROWS = 8
function BenillaKartFinder_SetTab(id) local f = BenillaKartFinder if id == 2 then f.mode = "player" BenillaKart_Send("PubL") else f.mode = nil end if PanelTemplates_SetTab then PanelTemplates_SetTab(BenillaKartFinderFrame, id) end BenillaKartFinder_Refresh() end
function BenillaKartFinder_PickTrack(id) BenillaKartFinder.track = id BenillaKartFinder_Refresh() end
-- The tab's sorts, cycled by its button: the newest first (as the server lists them), the -- best rated (good less bad votes), or by name. BENILLA_KART_PLAYER_SORTS = { "new", "rating", "name" } BENILLA_KART_PLAYER_SORT_LABELS = { new = "Sort: Newest", rating = "Sort: Rating", name = "Sort: A-Z" }
function BenillaKartFinder_CycleSort() local f = BenillaKartFinder local sorts = BENILLA_KART_PLAYER_SORTS local now = f.sort or "new" for i = 1, table.getn(sorts) do if sorts[i] == now then f.sort = sorts[i + 1] or sorts[1] break end end BenillaKartFinderPlayer_Update() end
-- The player tracks in the tab's sort, ties the newest first. function BenillaKartFinderPlayer_Shown() local sort = BenillaKartFinder.sort or "new" local list = {} for i = 1, table.getn(BenillaKartPubTracks) do table.insert(list, BenillaKartPubTracks[i]) end table.sort(list, function(a, b) if sort == "rating" and a.good - a.bad ~= b.good - b.bad then return a.good - a.bad > b.good - b.bad elseif sort == "name" and string.lower(a.name) ~= string.lower(b.name) then return string.lower(a.name) < string.lower(b.name) end return a.order < b.order end) return list end
function BenillaKartFinderPlayer_Update() local list = BenillaKartFinderPlayer_Shown() BenillaKartFinderFramePlayerSort:SetText(BENILLA_KART_PLAYER_SORT_LABELS[BenillaKartFinder.sort or "new"]) local offset = 0 if FauxScrollFrame_Update then local scroll = BenillaKartFinderFramePlayerScroll FauxScrollFrame_Update(scroll, table.getn(list), BENILLA_KART_PLAYER_ROWS, BENILLA_KART_ROW_HEIGHT) if BenillaScrollTrough_Follow then BenillaScrollTrough_Follow(scroll:GetName()) end offset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(scroll) end local f = BenillaKartFinder for i = 1, BENILLA_KART_PLAYER_ROWS do local row = getglobal("BenillaKartFinderFramePlayerRow" .. i) local track = list[offset + i] if track then row.id = track.id getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Name"):SetText(track.name .. " |cff40ff40+" .. track.good .. "|r |cffff5050-" .. track.bad .. "|r") getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Zone"):SetText("by " .. track.author) if track.id == f.track then row:LockHighlight() else row:UnlockHighlight() end row:Show() else row.id = nil row:Hide() end end if f.track then BenillaKartFinderFramePlayerTrial:Enable() else BenillaKartFinderFramePlayerTrial:Disable() end end
-- The picked player track's time trial: the server takes us to its grid, as the track -- browser's time trial does. function BenillaKartFinder_PlayerTrial() local id = BenillaKartFinder.track if not id then return end BenillaKart_Send("TB\tpt-" .. id) BenillaKartFinderFrame:Hide() end
-- The controller in the Race Finder, as in the track browser: the D-pad moves a cursor -- down "Any course", the courses and the hosted races (L1 and R1 a page), the list -- following it; Cross ticks the course under it or joins the race; Start finds a race, -- or leaves the queue; Circle closes (or minimizes, queued). BENILLA_KART_FINDER_PAD_STEPS = { PADDUP = -1, PADDDOWN = 1, PADLSHOULDER = -BENILLA_KART_ROWS, PADRSHOULDER = BENILLA_KART_ROWS } function BenillaKartFinder_Pad(key) local f = BenillaKartFinder local list = BenillaKartFinder_Shown() local n = table.getn(list) local lobbies = math.min(table.getn(BenillaKartLobby.races), BENILLA_KART_LOBBY_ROWS) local at = math.max(0, math.min(f.padAt or 0, n + lobbies)) local step = BENILLA_KART_FINDER_PAD_STEPS[key] if step then at = math.max(0, math.min(n + lobbies, at + step)) elseif key == "PAD1" then if at == 0 then BenillaKartFinder_Pick(nil) elseif at <= n then BenillaKartFinder_Pick(list[at].key) else BenillaKartLobby_Join(getglobal("BenillaKartFinderFrameLobby" .. (at - n))) end elseif key == "PADFORWARD" then BenillaKartFinder_QueueClick() elseif key == "PAD2" then BenillaKartFinderFrameClose:Click() return end f.padAt = at -- A course under the cursor into view, at the list's top or bottom edge. if at >= 1 and at <= n then local bar = getglobal("BenillaKartFinderFrameScrollScrollBar") local offset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset and FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(BenillaKartFinderFrameScroll) or 0 if bar and at <= offset then bar:SetValue((at - 1) * BENILLA_KART_ROW_HEIGHT) elseif bar and at > offset + BENILLA_KART_ROWS then bar:SetValue((at - BENILLA_KART_ROWS) * BENILLA_KART_ROW_HEIGHT) end end BenillaKartFinder_Refresh() local item = BenillaKartFinderFrameAny if at >= 1 and at <= n then for i = 1, BENILLA_KART_ROWS do local row = getglobal("BenillaKartFinderFrameRow" .. i) if row.key == list[at].key then item = row end end elseif at > n then item = getglobal("BenillaKartFinderFrameLobby" .. (at - n) .. "Join") end BenillaPad_Show(item) end
-- BENILLA_KART_COURSE_NAMES: every course, one "key<TAB>name" a line. function BenillaKartCourseNames_Set(list) BenillaKartCourseNames = {} local lines = BenillaKart_Split(string.gsub(list or "", "\n", "\t")) for i = 1, table.getn(lines) - 1, 2 do BenillaKartCourseNames[lines[i]] = lines[i + 1] end end
-- BENILLA_KART_COURSES: one "key<TAB>name" a line, in one argument, so a long list fits. function BenillaKartCourses_Set(list) BenillaKartCourses = {} local lines = BenillaKart_Split(string.gsub(list or "", "\n", "\t")) for i = 1, table.getn(lines) - 1, 2 do table.insert(BenillaKartCourses, { key = lines[i], name = lines[i + 1] }) end BenillaKartFinder_Refresh() end
-- Each race's course key by race id, from the server's "C"; the time trials by race id, -- from its "TT". BenillaKartRaceCourse = {} BenillaKartRaceTrial = {}
-- A finish that beat a best ("r" a course record, "p" a personal best) goes to the chat: -- anyone's record, and our own best. A time trial's are on its own board. function BenillaKart_Finished(race, name, ms, best) if not DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME or not ms or (best ~= "r" and best ~= "p") then return end local time = format("%d:%02d.%02d", floor(ms / 60000), mod(floor(ms / 1000), 60), floor(mod(ms, 1000) / 10)) local course = BenillaKart_CourseName(BenillaKartRaceCourse[race or ""] or "") local trial = BenillaKartRaceTrial[race or ""] if best == "r" and trial then DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME:AddMessage(format("%s set a new time trial record on %s: %s!", name, course, time), 1, 0.82, 0) elseif best == "r" then DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME:AddMessage(format("%s set a new course record on %s: %s!", name, course, time), 1, 0.82, 0) elseif name == UnitName("player") and trial then DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME:AddMessage(format("New time trial best on %s: %s.", course, time), 1, 0.82, 0) elseif name == UnitName("player") then DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME:AddMessage(format("New personal best on %s: %s.", course, time), 1, 0.82, 0) end end
-- ── Courier Jobs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- Today's courier deliveries as a job market (the server's "Jobs", "Job"): what the crate -- holds, where from and to, how far, its par and whether it's open, under way or -- delivered. Take job puts us in front of its courier ("JT"); the job starts when we take -- their quest. Cancel job abandons the one under way, the package with it. BENILLA_KART_JOB_ROWS = 10 BenillaKartJobs = { list = {}, tracks = {} } BENILLA_KART_JOB_STATES = { [0] = "|cffffffffOpen|r", [1] = "|cffffd100Under way|r", [2] = "|cff40ff40Delivered|r" }
function BenillaKartJobs_Open() BenillaKart_Open(BenillaKartJobsFrame) if not BenillaKartJobsFrame:IsVisible() then return end BenillaKart_Send("JL") BenillaKartJobs_Refresh() end
function BenillaKartJobs_Toggle() if BenillaKartJobsFrame:IsVisible() then BenillaKartJobsFrame:Hide() else BenillaKartJobs_Open() end end
function BenillaKartJobs_Begin(count) BenillaKartJobs.list = {} BenillaKartJobs.count = count or 0 BenillaKartJobs_Refresh() end
-- "Job": <i> <quest> <state> <from> <to> <giver> <recipient> <yards> <par> <cargo> <map> -- <giver x> <giver y> <recipient x> <recipient y>, from line[3] on. function BenillaKartJobs_Set(line) local i = tonumber(line[3]) if not i then return end local job = { quest = line[4], state = tonumber(line[5]) or 0, from = line[6], to = line[7], giver = line[8], recipient = line[9], yards = tonumber(line[10]) or 0, par = tonumber(line[11]) or 0, cargo = line[12], map = tonumber(line[13]) or 0 } BenillaKartJobs.list[i] = job -- Its ends on the world map, as a track's route is drawn (BenillaKartRoute_Show). BenillaKartJobs.tracks["job:" .. job.quest] = { key = "job:" .. job.quest, map = job.map, zone = "", laps = 0, points = { { tonumber(line[14]) or 0, tonumber(line[15]) or 0 }, { tonumber(line[16]) or 0, tonumber(line[17]) or 0 } } } if not BenillaKartJobs.selected then BenillaKartJobs.selected = 1 end BenillaKartJobs_Refresh() end
function BenillaKartJobs_Clock(seconds) return format("%d:%02d", floor(seconds / 60), mod(seconds, 60)) end
function BenillaKartJobs_Yards(yards) if yards >= 1000 then return format("%.1fk yd", yards / 1000) end return yards .. " yd" end
-- Whether a job is under way: then none other is taken. function BenillaKartJobs_Busy() local list = BenillaKartJobs.list for i = 1, BenillaKartJobs.count or 0 do if list[i] and list[i].state == 1 then return true end end return false end
function BenillaKartJobs_Refresh() local frame = BenillaKartJobsFrame if not frame or not frame:IsVisible() then return end local list = BenillaKartJobs.list for i = 1, BENILLA_KART_JOB_ROWS do local row = getglobal("BenillaKartJobsFrameRow" .. i) local job = list[i] if job then local name = row:GetName() getglobal(name .. "Cargo"):SetText(job.cargo) getglobal(name .. "Route"):SetText(job.from .. " to " .. job.to) getglobal(name .. "Distance"):SetText(BenillaKartJobs_Yards(job.yards)) getglobal(name .. "Par"):SetText(BenillaKartJobs_Clock(job.par)) getglobal(name .. -- Course lines, as BENILLA_KART_TRACKS sends them, as tracks; `fields` a line (7, or 9 -- with a saved track's grid and gates). function BenillaKartTracks_Parse(list, fields) fields = fields or 7 local tracks = {} local lines = BenillaKart_Split(string.gsub(list or "", "\n", "\t")) for i = 1, table.getn(lines) - fields + 1, fields do local points = {} local items = BenillaKart_Split(string.gsub(lines[i + 6], ";", "\t")) for j = 1, table.getn(items) do local comma = string.find(items[j], ",", 1, 1) if comma then table.insert(points, { tonumber(string.sub(items[j], 1, comma - 1)), tonumber(string.sub(items[j], comma + 1)) }) end end table.insert(tracks, { key = lines[i], name = lines[i + 1], zone = lines[i + 2], map = tonumber(lines[i + 3]) or 0, laps = tonumber(lines[i + 4]) or 0, text = lines[i + 5], points = points, grid = lines[i + 7], gates = lines[i + 8] }) end return tracks end

BENILLA_KART_TRACK_PAD_STEPS = { PADDUP = -1, PADDDOWN = 1, PADLSHOULDER = -BENILLA_KART_TRACK_ROWS, PADRSHOULDER = BENILLA_KART_TRACK_ROWS } function BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Pad(key) local step = BENILLA_KART_TRACK_PAD_STEPS[key] if step then local list = BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Shown() local n = table.getn(list) if n == 0 then return end local at = 0 for i = 1, n do if list[i].key == BenillaKartTrackBrowser.selected then at = i end end local to = at == 0 and 1 or math.max(1, math.min(n, at + step)) -- The picked row into view, at the list's top or bottom edge. local bar = getglobal("BenillaKartTracksFrameScrollScrollBar") local offset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset and FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(BenillaKartTracksFrameScroll) or 0 if bar and to <= offset then bar:SetValue((to - 1) * BENILLA_KART_TRACK_ROW_HEIGHT) elseif bar and to > offset + BENILLA_KART_TRACK_ROWS then bar:SetValue((to - BENILLA_KART_TRACK_ROWS) * BENILLA_KART_TRACK_ROW_HEIGHT) end BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Select(list[to].key) elseif key == "PAD1" then BenillaKartTrackBrowser_TimeTrial() elseif key == "PAD3" then BenillaKartTrackBrowser_ToMarshal() elseif key == "PAD4" then if BenillaKartTracksFrameShow:IsEnabled() == 1 then BenillaKartTracksFrameShow:Click() end elseif key == "PADBACK" then if BenillaKartTracksFrameRate:IsEnabled() == 1 then BenillaKartTracksFrameRate:Click() end elseif key == "PAD2" then BenillaKartTracksFrame:Hide() end end

-- Puts a dot at world (x, y) on the displayed map, or hides it off the map. function BenillaKartRoute_Place(layer, dot, map, x, y, size, r, g, b) local u, v = GetWorldLocMapPosition(map, x, y) if u == 0 and v == 0 then dot:Hide() return end dot:SetTexture(r, g, b, 1) dot:SetWidth(size) dot:SetHeight(size) dot:ClearAllPoints() dot:SetPoint("CENTER", layer, "TOPLEFT", u * layer:GetWidth(), -v * layer:GetHeight()) dot:Show() end
-- The shown course's trail on the displayed map: a dot each ROUTE_STEP yards along it, -- bigger at the checkpoints, the start marked; again at every map change. function BenillaKartRoute_Draw() local track = BenillaKartRoute.key and BenillaKartTrack(BenillaKartRoute.key) local layer = BenillaKartRouteFrame if not track or not layer then return end local points = track.points local count = table.getn(points) local n = 0 -- A circuit runs back to its first checkpoint; a sprint ends at its last. local legs = count - 1 if track.laps > 0 then legs = count end for i = 1, legs do local a, b = points[i], points[mod(i, count) + 1] local length = math.sqrt((b[1] - a[1]) ^ 2 + (b[2] - a[2]) ^ 2) local steps = math.max(1, floor(length / BENILLA_KART_ROUTE_STEP)) for k = 0, steps - 1 do local t = k / steps n = n + 1 local size, r, g, bl = 3, 1, 0.55, 0.1 if k == 0 then size, r, g, bl = 6, 1, 0.85, 0.1 end BenillaKartRoute_Place(layer, BenillaKartRoute_Dot(layer, n), track.map, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * t, size, r, g, bl) end end if legs < count and count > 0 then n = n + 1 local last = points[count] BenillaKartRoute_Place(layer, BenillaKartRoute_Dot(layer, n), track.map, last[1], last[2], 8, 0.9, 0.2, 0.2) end for i = n + 1, table.getn(BenillaKartRoute.dots) do BenillaKartRoute.dots[i]:Hide() end if not BenillaKartRouteStart then BenillaKartRouteStart = layer:CreateTexture("BenillaKartRouteStart", "OVERLAY") end if count > 0 then BenillaKartRoute_Place(layer, BenillaKartRouteStart, track.map, points[1][1], points[1][2], 10, 0.2, 1, 0.2) end end
-- The world map's zone for a course: its continent by map id, its zone by name. function BenillaKartRoute_Zoom(track) if not GetMapContinents or not SetMapZoom then return end local want = "Eastern Kingdoms" if track.map == 1 then want = "Kalimdor" end local continents = { GetMapContinents() } for c = 1, table.getn(continents) do if continents[c] == want then local zones = { GetMapZones(c) } for z = 1, table.getn(zones) do if zones[z] == track.zone then SetMapZoom(c, z) return end end SetMapZoom(c) return end end end
-- "Show on map": the world map opens at the course's zone with its route, the last one -- taken away. function BenillaKartRoute_Show(key) local track = BenillaKartTrack(key) if not track then return end local layer = BenillaKartRoute_Layer() if not layer then return end BenillaKartRoute_Clear() if WorldMapFrame and not WorldMapFrame:IsVisible() then -- The map is a full-screen panel: it hides UIParent and every window with it. function BenillaKartMap_Place(tex, x, y, size, r, g, b, a) local px, py = BenillaKartMap_At(x, y) tex:SetTexture(r, g, b) tex:SetAlpha(a or 1) tex:SetWidth(size) tex:SetHeight(size) tex:ClearAllPoints() tex:SetPoint("CENTER", BenillaKartMapFrameCanvas, "TOPLEFT", px, -py) tex:Show() end
function BenillaKartMap_Dot(pool, n, parent, layer) if not pool[n] then pool[n] = parent:CreateTexture(nil, layer) end return pool[n] end
function BenillaKartMap_SetTrack(name, laps, list) BenillaKartShortcuts.racing = name ~= nil and name ~= "" BenillaKartShortcuts_Update() local m = BenillaKartMap if not name or name == "" then BenillaKartMapFrame:Hide() return end local points = {} local items = BenillaKart_Split(string.gsub(list or "", ";", "\t")) for i = 1, table.getn(items) do local comma = string.find(items[i], ",", 1, 1) if comma then table.insert(points, { tonumber(string.sub(items[i], 1, comma - 1)), tonumber(string.sub(items[i], comma + 1)) }) end end local count = table.getn(points) if count < 2 then BenillaKartMapFrame:Hide() return end local minx, maxx, miny, maxy = points[1][1], points[1][1], points[1][2], points[1][2] for i = 2, count do minx = math.min(minx, points[i][1]); maxx = math.max(maxx, points[i][1]) miny = math.min(miny, points[i][2]); maxy = math.max(maxy, points[i][2]) end m.cx, m.cy = (minx + maxx) / 2, (miny + maxy) / 2 m.scale = BENILLA_KART_MAP_SIZE * 0.88 / math.max(maxx - minx, maxy - miny, 1) BenillaKartMapFrameTitle:SetText(name) -- The trail: a circuit back round to its start, a sprint to its finish. local legs = count - 1 if (tonumber(laps) or 0) > 0 then legs = count end local n = 0 for i = 1, legs do local a, b = points[i], points[mod(i, count) + 1] local ax, ay = BenillaKartMap_At(a[1], a[2]) local bx, by = BenillaKartMap_At(b[1], b[2]) local steps = math.max(1, floor(math.sqrt((bx - ax) * (bx - ax) + (by - ay) * (by - ay)) / BENILLA_KART_MAP_STEP)) for k = 0, steps - 1 do local t = k / steps n = n + 1 BenillaKartMap_Place(BenillaKartMap_Dot(m.route, n, BenillaKartMapFrameCanvas, "ARTWORK"), a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * t, 2, 0.85, 0.75, 0.55, 0.9) end end if legs < count then n = n + 1 BenillaKartMap_Place(BenillaKartMap_Dot(m.route, n, BenillaKartMapFrameCanvas, "ARTWORK"), points[count][1], points[count][2], 6, 0.9, 0.2, 0.2) end n = n + 1 BenillaKartMap_Place(BenillaKartMap_Dot(m.route, n, BenillaKartMapFrameCanvas, "ARTWORK"), points[1][1], points[1][2], 6, 0.2, 1, 0.2) for i = n + 1, table.getn(m.route) do m.route[i]:Hide() end BenillaKartMapFrame:Show() end
function BenillaKartMap_SetRacers(list) local m = BenillaKartMap local n, seen = 0, nil local lines = BenillaKart_Split(string.gsub(list or "", "\n", "\t")) if m.scale then for i = 1, table.getn(lines) - 5, 6 do local x, y = tonumber(lines[i + 1]), tonumber(lines[i + 2]) local place, me, near = tonumber(lines[i + 3]) or 0, lines[i + 4] == "1", lines[i + 5] == "1" if x and y then n = n + 1 local alpha = 1 if not near then alpha = 0.45 end if me then -- Us on a layer of our own, above everyone else. if not m.me then m.me = BenillaKartMapFrameCanvasTop:CreateTexture(nil, "OVERLAY") end BenillaKartMap_Place(m.me, x, y, 9, 1, 0.9, 0.2, 1) seen = 1 if m.racers[n] then m.racers[n]:Hide() end else BenillaKartMap_Place(BenillaKartMap_Dot(m.racers, n, BenillaKartMapFrameCanvas, "OVERLAY"), x, y, 7, 0.95, 0.25, 0.2, alpha) end local label = m.labels[n] if not label then label = BenillaKartMapFrameCanvasTop:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontHighlightSmall") m.labels[n] = label end local px, py = BenillaKartMap_At(x, y) label:ClearAllPoints() label:SetPoint("LEFT", BenillaKartMapFrameCanvas, "TOPLEFT", px + 6, -py) if place > 0 then label:SetText(place) else label:SetText("") end label:SetAlpha(alpha) label:Show() end end end for i = n + 1, table.getn(m.racers) do m.racers[i]:Hide() end for i = n + 1, table.getn(m.labels) do m.labels[i]:Hide() end if m.me and not seen then m.me:Hide() end end
-- The server's replies. function BenillaKartFinder_OnLine(message) local f = BenillaKartFinder local line = BenillaKart_Split(message) if line[1] ~= "R" then return end f.dirty = 1 local verb = line[2] if verb == "Qs" then f.waiting, f.waited = tonumber(line[3]), tonumber(line[4]) elseif verb == "Qx" then f.queued, f.waiting, f.waited = nil, nil, nil if line[3] == "racing" then f.noticeUntil = GetTime() + 6 end if line[3] == "party" then BenillaKart_Say("Your party left the Race Finder queue.") end elseif verb == "Qp" then -- A party mate queued the party: we are queued too, and keep our place ourselves. f.queued, f.waiting, f.waited, f.noticeUntil = line[3], nil, nil, 0 f.beat = GetTime() BenillaKart_Say(format("%s queued your party in the Race Finder.", line[4] or "Your party")) elseif verb == "Pop" then f.check = { id = line[3], course = line[4], racers = tonumber(line[5]) or 0 } if StaticPopupDialogs then StaticPopupDialogs["BENILLA_KART_READY"].timeout = tonumber(line[6]) or 20 StaticPopup_Show("BENILLA_KART_READY", BenillaKart_CourseName(line[4]), f.check.racers) end elseif verb == "Pop-" then -- The server queues again those who accepted. if f.check and not f.check.answered then f.queued = nil end f.check = nil if StaticPopup_Hide then StaticPopup_Hide("BENILLA_KART_READY") end elseif verb == "Finder" then -- The Race Marshal's "Open the Race Finder". BenillaKart_Open(BenillaKartFinderFrame) elseif verb == "Tracks" then -- The Race Marshal's "Browse the tracks", at her own course. BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Open(line[3] ~= "" and line[3] or nil) elseif verb == "Lobby" then BenillaKartLobby_Set(line[3], line[4]) elseif verb == "Ux" then BenillaKart_Say(format("Unstuck: you can use it again in %d seconds.", tonumber(line[3]) or 0)) elseif verb == "PTB" or verb == "PT" or verb == "PTE" or verb == "PubOk" or verb == "PubNo" or verb == "PubGone" then BenillaKartPub_Line(line) elseif verb == "TGx" then BenillaKart_Say(format("The trip to the test lap's grid is ready again in %d seconds:" .. " drive onto the grid, or Restart then.", tonumber(line[3]) or 0)) elseif verb == "TGf" then BenillaKart_Say("The test lap's grid is over 1000 yards away, too far to be taken" .. " there: drive onto it.") elseif verb == "MTx" then BenillaKart_Say(format("You can travel to a Race Marshal again in %d seconds.", tonumber(line[3]) or 0)) elseif verb == "Un" then BenillaKart_Say("Unstuck: no course starts within 300 yards.") elseif verb == "M" then SetCVar("KartRaceMode", line[3] == "1" and "1" or "0") if line[3] == "1" then BenillaKartRaceMode = 1 BenillaKart_Say("Race mode on: nobody can target or attack you, and you can't attack anyone.") else BenillaKartRaceMode = nil BenillaKart_Say("Race mode off.") end elseif verb == "RateAsk" then -- After a race: how was the track? BenillaKartRate_Ask(line[3]) elseif verb == "Off" then -- The tracks the owner has taken out: the browser hides them. BenillaKartOff = {} for key in string.gfind(line[3] or "", "[^,]+") do BenillaKartOff[key] = 1 end if BenillaKartTracksFrame:IsVisible() then BenillaKartTrackBrowser_Refresh() end elseif verb == "CC" then -- A cosmetics catalogue: "P" the paints, "T" the trails, each name:stat:need. local list = {} for entry in string.gfind(line[4] or "", "[^;]+") do local _, _, name, stat, need = string.find(entry, "^(.*):(%d+):(%d+)$") if name then table.insert(list, { name = name, stat = tonumber(stat), need = tonumber(need) }) end end BenillaKartLook.lists[line[3] or ""] = list elseif verb == "CO" then -- Our numbers and what we wear: the garage's Look rows, and the kart's (KartPaint, -- KartTrail). local look = BenillaKartLook look.stats = {} for n in string.gfind(line[3] or "", "%d+") do table.insert(look.stats, tonumber(n)) end look.worn.P = tonumber(line[4]) or 0 look.worn.T = tonumber(line[5]) or 0 look.view.P, look.view.T = look.worn.P, look.worn.T SetCVar("KartPaint", look.worn.P) SetCVar("KartTrail", look.worn.T) if BenillaKartGarageFrame:IsVisible() then BenillaKartGarage_Refresh() end elseif verb == "HopBest" then -- A Skyhop finish kept (Kartcraft.cpp "Skyhop"): the time, our best, the record. local function clock(ms) return format("%.2f s", (tonumber(ms) or 0) / 1000) end local text = "Skyhop: " .. clock(line[4]) .. ". Your best: " .. clock(line[5]) .. ". Record: " .. clock(line[6]) .. " by " .. (line[7] or "?") .. "." if line[4] == line[6] then text = "Skyhop record! " .. text end UIErrorsFrame:AddMessage(text, 1, 0.82, 0, 1, 6) BenillaKart_Say(text) elseif verb == "CrateOdds" then -- The crate's price, opens left today, pity counts, what we lack by tier ("-" closed), -- the odds and the pity's reach. local c = BenillaKartCrate BENILLA_KART_CRATE.price = tonumber(line[3]) or BENILLA_KART_CRATE.price c.left = tonumber(line[4]) or 0 c.sinceEpic, c.sinceLegendary = tonumber(line[5]) or 0, tonumber(line[6]) or 0 c.open = line[7] ~= nil and line[7] ~= "-" c.lacking, c.weights = {}, {} for n in string.gfind(line[7] or "", "%d+") do table.insert(c.lacking, tonumber(n)) end for n in string.gfind(line[8] or "", "%d+") do table.insert(c.weights, tonumber(n)) end c.pityEpic, c.pityLegendary = tonumber(line[9]) or 0, tonumber(line[10]) or 0 if BenillaKartShopFrame:IsVisible() then BenillaKartShop_Refresh() end elseif verb == "Crate" then BenillaKartCrate_Reveal(line[3], line[4]) elseif verb == "Open" then -- The hub's Quartermaster opens a window: the garage or the shop. if line[3] == "garage" then BenillaKart_Open(BenillaKartGarageFrame) elseif line[3] == "shop" then BenillaKart_Open(BenillaKartShopFrame) end elseif verb == "ACGot" then -- A cache claimed (Kartcraft.cpp "Caches"): what it held, said and sounded. local copper, tokens = tonumber(line[3]) or 0, tonumber(line[4]) or 0 local name = line[5] == "1" and "an Astral Cache" or "a Wumpa Cache" local text = "You found " .. name .. ": " .. BenillaKart_Money(copper) if tokens > 0 then text = text .. " and " .. tokens .. " Kartcraft Tokens" end UIErrorsFrame:AddMessage(text .. "!", 1, 0.82, 0, 1, 4) BenillaKart_Say(text .. ".") PlaySound("LOOTWINDOWCOINSOUND") elseif verb == "Goods" then -- Our own cosmetics: tokens, the flag we fly, the goods we own. A custom kart picked -- but not ours (another character's pick) goes back to the CTR one. local goods = BenillaKartGoods BenillaKartShop.tokens = tonumber(line[3]) goods.flag = line[4] or "" goods.owned = {} for key in string.gfind(line[5] or "", "[^,]+") do goods.owned[key] = 1 end SetCVar("KartFlag", goods.flag) local racer = BenillaKartGoods_Find(GetCVar("KartRacer")) if racer and not goods.owned[racer.key] then SetCVar("KartRacer", "crash") end if BenillaKartShopFrame:IsVisible() then BenillaKartShop_Refresh() end if BenillaKartGarageFrame:IsVisible() then BenillaKartGarage_Refresh() end elseif verb == "Skins" then -- The skin shop's purse and what is ours: tokens, the skin worn, the skins owned. local shop = BenillaKartShop shop.tokens = tonumber(line[3]) shop.worn = line[4] or "" shop.owned = {} for key in string.gfind(line[5] or "", "[^,]+") do shop.owned[key] = 1 end if BenillaKartShopFrame:IsVisible() then BenillaKartShop_Refresh() end elseif verb == "CH" then -- The day's and the week's challenge courses, and their boards. BenillaKartChallenge = { daily = line[3], weekly = line[4], dailyMine = tonumber(line[5]) or 0, dailyLeader = line[6] or "", dailyLeaderMs = tonumber(line[7]) or 0, weeklyMine = tonumber(line[8]) or 0, weeklyLeader = line[9] or "", weeklyLeaderMs = tonumber(line[10]) or 0, } if BenillaKartMenuFrame and BenillaKartMenuFrame:IsVisible() then BenillaKartMenu_Refresh() end elseif verb == "Mx" then BenillaKart_Say("Race mode: not while you're in combat.") elseif verb == "X" then -- Out of every race and the queue (/leaverace, the minimap button's menu). f.check, f.queued, f.waiting, f.waited = nil, nil, nil, nil if StaticPopup_Hide then StaticPopup_Hide("BENILLA_KART_READY") end if DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME then DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME:AddMessage("You left every race and the Race Finder queue.", 1, 0.82, 0) end elseif verb == "C" then -- A race's course, to name it when someone sets a record there. BenillaKartRaceCourse[line[3] or ""] = line[4] elseif verb == "TT" then -- A time trial: its records are the time trials'. BenillaKartRaceTrial[line[3] or ""] = 1 elseif verb == "F" then BenillaKart_Finished(line[3], line[4], tonumber(line[6]), line[7]) elseif verb == "Ret" then -- Our Race Finder race or track browser time trial is over: back to where it took -- us from? After a time trial (its course named), or another go at it. BenillaKartRetryButton.course = line[3] if StaticPopup_Show then StaticPopup_Show(line[3] and "BENILLA_KART_RETURN_TRIAL" or "BENILLA_KART_RETURN") end elseif verb == "Again" then -- A time trial with no spot to go back to (the Race Marshal's) is over. BenillaKartRetryButton.course = line[3] if StaticPopup_Show then StaticPopup_Show("BENILLA_KART_AGAIN") end elseif verb == "Jobs" then BenillaKartJobs_Begin(tonumber(line[3]) or 0) elseif verb == "Job" then BenillaKartJobs_Set(line) elseif verb == "JTx" then BenillaKart_Say(format("You can take another job in %d seconds.", tonumber(line[3]) or 0)) elseif verb == "Del" then -- A courier delivery under way: its town, par and the seconds already gone. BenillaKartDelivery_Start(line[3], tonumber(line[4]) or 0, tonumber(line[5]) or 0) elseif verb == "Del-" then BenillaKartDelivery_Stop() elseif verb == "MDel" then -- A Marathon Delivery's next stop: its town, the route's par, the seconds gone, and -- which stop of how many. BenillaKartDelivery_Start(line[3], tonumber(line[4]) or 0, tonumber(line[5]) or 0, tonumber(line[6]) or 1, tonumber(line[7]) or 1) BenillaKartMarathon.goAt = nil BenillaKartMarathonFrame:Hide() elseif verb == "MarOpen" then BenillaKartMarathon_Open(tonumber(line[3]) or 0, line[4]) elseif verb == "MarQ" then BenillaKartMarathon_Queue(tonumber(line[3]) or 0, line[4] == "1") elseif verb == "MarShut" then BenillaKartMarathon_Shut() elseif verb == "MarGo" then BenillaKartMarathon_Go(tonumber(line[3]) or 0) elseif verb == "MarDone" then BenillaKartMarathon_Done(tonumber(line[3]), tonumber(line[4]), tonumber(line[5])) elseif verb == "MarEnd" then BenillaKartMarathon_End() elseif verb == "L" then -- A roster with us in it: we are in a race, so the finder is done and closes. local me = UnitName("player") if me and string.find("," .. (line[4] or "") .. ",", "," .. me .. ",", 1, 1) then BenillaKartRaceNow = line[3] f.check, f.queued, f.waiting, f.waited = nil, nil, nil, nil if StaticPopup_Hide then StaticPopup_Hide("BENILLA_KART_READY") end BenillaKartFinderFrame:Hide() end end BenillaKartFinder_Refresh() end

BenillaKartRaceModeAsk = { at = 0, tries = 0 } function BenillaKart_RaceModeRetry() local a = BenillaKartRaceModeAsk if a.tries == 0 or a.tries >= 6 or BenillaKartRaceMode or GetCVar("KartRaceMode") == "0" then return end if GetTime() < a.at or (UnitAffectingCombat and UnitAffectingCombat("player")) then return end a.at = GetTime() + 5 a.tries = a.tries + 1 BenillaKart_Send("M\t1") end

-- A window's controls in reading order: shown and enabled buttons and check boxes, and -- sliders, but no scroll bar's own. function BenillaPad_Items(frame) local items = {} local function walk(f) local kids = { f:GetChildren() } for i = 1, table.getn(kids) do local k = kids[i] local name = k:GetName() or "" if k:IsVisible() and not string.find(name, "ScrollBar") then local t = k:GetObjectType() if (t == "Button" or t == "CheckButton") and k:IsEnabled() == 1 then table.insert(items, k) elseif t == "Slider" then table.insert(items, k) end if t ~= "Slider" then walk(k) end end end end walk(frame) return items end
local function BenillaPad_Centre(item) local l, b, w, h = item:GetLeft(), item:GetBottom(), item:GetWidth(), item:GetHeight() if not l or not b then return 0, 0 end return l + w / 2, b + h / 2 end
-- The highlight: the focused button lit, and an arrow at its left. function BenillaPad_Show(item) local old = BenillaPad.focus if old and old ~= item and old.UnlockHighlight then old:UnlockHighlight() end BenillaPad.focus = item if not item then BenillaPadCursor:Hide() return end if item.LockHighlight then item:LockHighlight() end BenillaPadCursor:ClearAllPoints() BenillaPadCursor:SetPoint("RIGHT", item, "LEFT", -2, 0) BenillaPadCursor:Show() end
-- The control nearest the focus in a direction (dx, dy one of -1, 0, 1, up positive): the -- least distance along it, sideways distance counting double. function BenillaPad_Nearest(items, from, dx, dy) local fx, fy = BenillaPad_Centre(from) local best, score for i = 1, table.getn(items) do local it = items[i] if it ~= from then local x, y = BenillaPad_Centre(it) local along = (x - fx) * dx + (y - fy) * dy local side = math.abs((x - fx) * dy) + math.abs((y - fy) * dx) if along > 2 then local s = along + 2 * side if not score or s < score then best, score = it, s end end end end return best end
-- The first control a window's focus starts on: the top one, the leftmost of those. function BenillaPad_First(items) local best, bx, by for i = 1, table.getn(items) do local x, y = BenillaPad_Centre(items[i]) if not best or y > by + 4 or (math.abs(y - by) <= 4 and x < bx) then best, bx, by = items[i], x, y end end return best end
-- A slider's step along its range. function BenillaPad_Slide(slider, dir) local lo, hi = slider:GetMinMaxValues() local step = slider.GetValueStep and slider:GetValueStep() or 0 if not step or step <= 0 then step = (hi - lo) / 20 end slider:SetValue(math.max(lo, math.min(hi, slider:GetValue() + dir * step))) end
-- A controller press, from the engine before its binding: true when a popup or a window -- took it. function BenillaPad_OnButton(key) if StaticPopup_Visible then for i = 1, table.getn(BENILLA_PAD_POPUPS) do local p = BENILLA_PAD_POPUPS[i] local dialog = StaticPopup_Visible(p.name) if dialog then if key == p.accept then getglobal(dialog .. "Button1"):Click() return true end if key == p.cancel then getglobal(dialog .. "Button2"):Click() return true end if key == p.retry then BenillaKartRetryButton:Click() return true end end end end local frame, w = BenillaPad_Window() if not frame then return false end if w.buttons and getglobal(w.buttons) then if getglobal(w.buttons)(key) ~= false then return true end end local items = BenillaPad_Items(frame) local focus = BenillaPad.focus local present = false for i = 1, table.getn(items) do if items[i] == focus then present = true end end if BenillaPad.window ~= frame or not present then BenillaPad.window = frame focus = BenillaPad_First(items) BenillaPad_Show(focus) -- The first press only finds the focus, unless it is the one that acts on it. if key ~= "PAD1" and key ~= "PAD2" then return true end end local dirs = { PADDUP = { 0, 1 }, PADDDOWN = { 0, -1 }, PADDLEFT = { -1, 0 }, PADDRIGHT = { 1, 0 } } local d = dirs[key] if d then if focus and focus:GetObjectType() == "Slider" and d[1] ~= 0 then BenillaPad_Slide(focus, d[1]) return true end local next = focus and BenillaPad_Nearest(items, focus, d[1], d[2]) if next then BenillaPad_Show(next) elseif d[2] ~= 0 and w.wheel and getglobal(w.wheel) then -- Past the list's end: scroll it a notch, the focus on the same row. getglobal(w.wheel)(d[2]) end return true elseif key == "PAD1" then if focus and focus:GetObjectType() ~= "Slider" then focus:Click() end return true elseif key == "PAD2" then frame:Hide() return true elseif (key == "PADLSHOULDER" or key == "PADRSHOULDER") and w.page and getglobal(w.page) then getglobal(w.page)(key == "PADLSHOULDER" and -1 or 1) return true end return false end

-- A value as it reads: lengths in yards, angles in degrees, shares in percent. function BenillaKartCamera_Format(unit, v) if unit == "yd" then return format("%.1f yd", v / BENILLA_KART_LU_PER_YARD) elseif unit == "deg" then return format("%.1f\194\176", v) elseif unit == "pct" then return format("%d%%", floor(v * 100 + 0.5)) elseif unit == "s" then if v <= 0 then return "none" end return format("%.2f s", v) elseif unit == "side" then if v == 0 then return "none" end local yd = format("%.1f yd", math.abs(v) / BENILLA_KART_LU_PER_YARD) if v > 0 then return yd .. " right" end return yd .. " left" elseif unit == "orbit" then if v == 0 then return "behind" end if v > 0 then return format("%d\194\176 right", floor(v + 0.5)) end return format("%d\194\176 left", floor(-v + 0.5)) end return tostring(v) end

-- The preset the CVars are, nil for Custom. function BenillaKartCamera_PresetOf() for i = 1, table.getn(BENILLA_KART_CAMERA_PRESETS) do local preset = BENILLA_KART_CAMERA_PRESETS[i] local same = 1 for cvar, value in pairs(preset.values) do if math.abs(BenillaKartCamera_Number(cvar) - tonumber(value)) > 0.0001 then same = nil end end if same then return preset end end end

-- The preset dropdown's list: the presets, and Custom, which only says the values are -- none of them. function BenillaKartCamera_PresetMenu() local current = BenillaKartCamera_PresetOf() for i = 1, table.getn(BENILLA_KART_CAMERA_PRESETS) do local preset = BENILLA_KART_CAMERA_PRESETS[i] local info = {} info.text = preset.text info.value = preset.key info.func = BenillaKartCamera_PresetClick if current == preset then info.checked = 1 end UIDropDownMenu_AddButton(info) end local info = {} info.text = "Custom" info.value = "custom" info.disabled = 1 if not current then info.checked = 1 end UIDropDownMenu_AddButton(info) end

-- From BENILLA_KART_GARAGE: our Karting skill, the classes { key, name, needs, about } in -- the order the skill opens them, and the racers { key, name } we have a kart for. BenillaKartGarage = { skill = 0, classes = {}, racers = {} } BENILLA_KART_GARAGE_CLASSES = 4 BENILLA_KART_GARAGE_RACERS = 16 BENILLA_KART_LOCKED_COLOR = { r = 0.5, g = 0.5, b = 0.5 }
-- `list`'s lines, each cut at its TABs. function BenillaKart_Rows(list) local rows, from = {}, 1 list = list or "" while from <= string.len(list) do local at = string.find(list, "\n", from, 1) or string.len(list) + 1 table.insert(rows, BenillaKart_Split(string.sub(list, from, at - 1))) from = at + 1 end return rows end
function BenillaKartGarage_Set(skill, classes, racers) local g = BenillaKartGarage g.skill = tonumber(skill) or 0 g.classes = {} local rows = BenillaKart_Rows(classes) for i = 1, table.getn(rows) do local r = rows[i] table.insert(g.classes, { key = r[1], name = r[2] or r[1], needs = tonumber(r[3]) or 0, about = r[4] or "" }) end g.racers = {} rows = BenillaKart_Rows(racers) for i = 1, table.getn(rows) do table.insert(g.racers, { key = rows[i][1], name = rows[i][2] or rows[i][1] }) end if BenillaKartGarageFrame:IsVisible() then BenillaKartGarage_Refresh() end end

function BenillaKartGarage_Unlocked(i) local c = BenillaKartGarage.classes[i] return c and BenillaKartGarage.skill >= c.needs end
-- The class the kart drives, as it decides (kart/garage.rs): the one picked if the skill -- has opened it, else the best opened one below it. function BenillaKartGarage_Driven() local classes = BenillaKartGarage.classes local picked = 1 for i = 1, table.getn(classes) do if classes[i].key == GetCVar("KartClass") then picked = i end end for i = picked, 1, -1 do if BenillaKartGarage_Unlocked(i) then return i end end return 1 end
